title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Bump. Also, I have to do a mid season top 15 prospects update/re-rank for tomorrow morning. Any input would be helpful.
Text it to me and I can see if it makes sense

I’m gonna keep Paredes ahead of Greene for now, just because he’s only two years older and   has been playing pro ball for like five years. ... I would be flipping Mize over Manning, based on first-half performance, pitches. ... would you sub anyone out for Lipcius or Quintana?
